title: Seat Coverage and Assignment Timing, Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions
content:
Under Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions, the seat covered, whether preferred seats are also covered, the itinerary classes on which seats are covered and the moment a covered seat may be assigned are fixed per subscription as follows.

| Subscription | Seat covered | Preferred seats also covered | Itinerary classes on which seats are covered | When a covered seat may be assigned |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Bag Pass One | None | No | None | Never (no seat benefit) |
| Crestline Bag Pass Two | None | No | None | Never (no seat benefit) |
| Crestline Seat Pass Domestic | Extra-legroom Main Plus seat | Yes | Domestic | At check-in |
| Crestline Seat Pass Network | Extra-legroom Main Plus seat | Yes | Domestic; short-haul international; long-haul international | At booking |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic | Extra-legroom Main Plus seat | Yes | Domestic | At check-in |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Network | Extra-legroom Main Plus seat | Yes | Domestic; short-haul international; long-haul international | At booking |

## The same schedule by itinerary class

| Itinerary class | Subscriptions covering a seat on it | Assignment timing |
|---|---|---|
| Domestic | Seat Pass Domestic, Seat and Bag Pass Domestic | At check-in |
| Domestic | Seat Pass Network, Seat and Bag Pass Network | At booking |
| Short-haul international | Seat Pass Network, Seat and Bag Pass Network | At booking |
| Long-haul international | Seat Pass Network, Seat and Bag Pass Network | At booking |

## Points of distinction

- **Domestic against Network.** The two Domestic seat subscriptions cover seats on domestic itineraries only and allow the covered seat to be assigned at check-in; the two Network seat subscriptions cover all three itinerary classes and allow assignment at booking.
- **Preferred seats.** Every subscription that covers an extra-legroom Main Plus seat also covers preferred seats.
- **Bag Passes.** Crestline Bag Pass One and Two carry no seat benefit at all: no seat is covered, on no itinerary class, at no time.
